head: 39430e23dcbae8e40df551dc53855a669250a79d
scope: Actual core.ts repair delta from26872, focused exactnew witnesses, cache lookup/oldrow safety. No wider Stage2/Stage3 verdict.
outcome: No new functional blocker found in the bounded repair. Both reproduced P1 causes are addressed.

cache.analysis: keptNow checks the stored policy version on initial cache hit, competing-record branch and final read. Version is recorded in every inserted/upserted body. An unversioned preexisting valid body returns null from every helper path, is reevaluated, and can be overwritten after still() succeeds; no schema alteration is required. The seal+upsert are in one synchronous transaction, and final keptNow has no intervening await.
cache.runtime: Exact new cache witness passed under shipped v2 declared config. It asserts original ready/pass and one call, block-only activation, same inputdigest, reevaluation count2, failed stage-rule, pass/block event sequence and no main change.
cache.oldrow_limit: Unversioned/preexisting row behavior assessed from the single helper and write path; no separate injected-row runtime witness authorized or run.

carry.analysis: The sealing transaction rereads targetspec and activepolicy and ends before retaining/sealing/storing if version changed or targetspec is missing/notcheck/anotherchecker. ended returns from the entire pass, so it does not retry a stale specification indefinitely. Existing actor/revocation fact retry remains. Guard also applies to the no-runner path.
carry.runtime: Removed-obligation witness passed under v2, asserts recomputation while carryheld, no check-carried event and published log verifies. Activation-overtaking witness passed in shipped v1 config, asserts one new-policy carry event, no extra landing checker service job and operation progresses toready/publishing/landed.
carry.meaning_limit: Service-dispatch assertion does not prove absence of every transient owed job database row. Historical policy acceptance and restart/liveness source review is owned by architecture helper.

documentation_note.text: The actor role is the role recorded in admission authority, while teams are read currently (core.ts926–927); the table implies both role and teams are current. Architecture helper already owns this wording correction.

limits: Real workerd/SQLite and real policy evaluator; shipped fake artifacts/publisher/checker service boundary, noprovider proof.
Only three exact new witnesses ran, no broad suite or mutationcontrols.
Old original request evidence and complete Stage3 carryaccounting remain separate.
confidence: High for the bounded repair and executed witness behavior.
